title: Normalized local lattice fibres and exactness on the rational heart
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, $\ell$ a prime invertible in $k$, and $X$ a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ and finite intermediate fields $E\subset L$ over $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Write $A_E=\mathcal O_E$, choose a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and put $B_{E,X}=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}(A_E/\varpi_E^n)_X$ and $E_X=B_{E,X}[1/\varpi_E]$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. These are the continuous completed coefficient sheaves on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the derived-complete constructible integral categories with compatible etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], their raw rationalizations $D^b_c(X,E)$ [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], their bounded localized standard t-structures [prop-weil-localized-tstructure], and the pair category $D^b_c(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category], with the finite scalar functors $T_{L/E}$ and associators of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension].

Let $\mathscr A_E(X)$ be the heart of this finite-stage t-structure, identified with constructible continuous $E_X$-module sheaves by $J_X$ [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization]. Constructible means lisse of finite rank on each stratum of a finite locally closed stratification [def-constructible-stratification]. For every geometric point $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ with $\Omega$ algebraically closed [def-weil-geometric-point], there is an $E$-linear functor $\omega_{\bar x,E}:\mathscr A_E(X)\to\operatorname{Vect}_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)$ with the following normalization. On an affine etale lattice chart of the lisse stratum at $\bar x$, let $(N_n)$ be the normalized finite locally free $A_E/\varpi_E^n$ etale reduction system of the chosen integral lattice [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves]. Then
$$\omega_{\bar x,E}(F)\cong\bigl(\varprojlim_n(N_n)_{\bar x}\bigr)\otimes_{A_E}E.$$
The inverse limit here is finite free over $A_E$, and an integral map of reduction systems divided by $\varpi_E^a$ induces $\varpi_E^{-a}$ times its inverse-limit fibre map. The fibre functor, these identifications and these maps are independent up to the comparison isomorphisms of the choice of adapted stratification, etale chart, lattice and fractional representative, and are natural in $F$. No global lisse integral lattice is required.

Each $\omega_{\bar x,E}$ is exact for the exact structure inherited from all continuous module sheaves. The family over all geometric points detects zero objects, isomorphisms, zero morphisms, and exactness of short complexes. In particular the fibre sequence of any short exact heart sequence is short exact, and conversely a short complex is short exact if its sequence of finite-dimensional fibres is so at every geometric point.
